Works without the website:
• When the store website is down (no internet, or its database is over its monthly limit) the app stops trying every few seconds and the Tickets tab says so, with ＋ Price cards for a customer, Saved offers and Try again. Scanning, CSVs, the offer, printing, Accept at the counter, Square upload and labels all work as usual
• Uses the website far less, so its database can sleep: iPad signatures are only checked for 3 hours after Show on iPad, invoice updates every 10 minutes
